rows.title: Pressure Converter
rows.semantics: Fixed signed scalar pressure-unit conversion. Standard atmosphere is a fixed unit. No gauge/absolute reference-model conversion or inferred offset.

currentDomainAndPrecision.methodology: UCUM [psi]=[lbf_av]/[in_i]2; conventional pound-force and international inch.
currentDomainAndPrecision.inputInterpretation: Exact supplied binary64 Number; no exact decimal-text quantization claim.
currentDomainAndPrecision.nonIdentityDomain: Zero, or 2^-970 <= abs(value) <= 2^990; nonzero output normal and finite.
currentDomainAndPrecision.identityDomain: Every finite supplied Number; zero normalized to standard JSON zero.
currentDomainAndPrecision.relativeBound: gamma4 = 4u/(1-4u), u=2^-53, relative to supplied Number times exact rational unit ratio.
limitations: Fixed scalar pressure-unit conversion only; no gauge/absolute reference-model conversion or pressure-offset inference.
